target: opening narrowly (of a flower at anthesis: perianth only slightly spread, flower ± cup-like)
fix: Not a process. It is the shape of the open flower. Add a value under PATO open (PATO:0000610), or a reviewed rule to a petal/perianth position if FNA's use is checked, with the flower as bearer.
reason: In the Drymocallis key, 'flowers opening narrowly' vs 'widely' describes the shape of the open flower. No term or rule covers it.

target: numerous (a count without a number: many parts of one kind)
fix: Add a FLOPO count value 'numerous' (synonym 'many') under PATO multiple (PATO:0002118), used with PATO amount on the counted part (pattern 03, without numeric bounds). Ground 'pennate nerves' to the leaf lamina's secondary (pinnate) veins, with the lamina as container.
reason: The count pattern holds 'few' and 'many' as not numeric. A qualitative count value is the only thing missing.

fix: Give the FLOPO liana class an EQ signature, or add a rule: whole plant (PO:0000003) has climbing (FLOPO:0991108). PATO has no 'woody' value, so woodiness can only be added later. 'élevée' is the height that follows (10–30 m) and is annotated on its own.
reason: Liana is a habit made of known qualities. Only the EQ mapping of the existing class is missing.

target: inflorescence branch (the branches of the paniculiform array), not the inflorescence
fix: Bearer: the inflorescence branch (counted part), with the inflorescence as container. Value 'numerous' as in P01681. The '10–45 cm' is the length of the branches.
reason: 'branches numerous' counts the branches of the head array. The inflorescence itself is not 'numerous'.

target: exsudant un latex / exuding latex → existing FLOPO_0900050 'latex present' (a rule, not a new class)
fix: Add a rule mapping 'exsudant/exuding (un) latex' on bark, bark slash or a cut part to latex present FLOPO_0900050. Keep the latex colour (blanc crème) in RDF only, because latex is not a PO entity.
reason: 'Exuding latex' is the existing latex-presence phenotype under another name, not an event.

fix: Same as P01682: EQ signature whole plant (PO:0000003) has climbing (FLOPO:0991108). The alternative 'ou parfois arbuste sarmenteux' then fits pattern 08.
reason: The liana class needs an EQ signature. Same case as P01682.

fix: 'at the apex' is a region row of config/flora_context_words.tsv, not a stage. The transcriber's stage qualifier must be checked against the region and surface kinds first. Result: fruit width 2.5 mm, with an apical region (BSPO) part restriction, because PO has no fruit apex.
reason: This is a place on the part, not a developmental stage. The annotator used the wrong kind for the qualifier.

fix: Read 'as long as or longer than X' as one comparison with ratio_low 1 and no upper bound. Quality is length (the range spans 1) towards stem internode (PO:0020142). 'usually' becomes the frequency qualifier.
reason: This is equality-or-more against another part, not a free disjunction of values. Pattern 10 covers it once the 'or longer' range is read.

fix: A colour range 'X to Y' must not go to the measurement parser. Continuum from desaturated yellow (PATO:0001286, synonym pale yellow) to orange yellow (PATO:0104054) on the corolla.
reason: Both colours ground in PATO. 'measurement_missing_unit' is a misrouting caused by 'to'.

fix: A bare count of 0 ('Bracts 0') is absence. Annotate bract with absent (PATO:0000462), or negated present, as for 'no petals', instead of asking for a unit.
reason: 'Bracts 0' is the flora's way of writing 'bracts absent'.

fix: Annotate 'upper glume attenuate' as upper glume (PO:0006004) + attenuate (PATO:0001982). The 'or' joins two apical outgrowths (mucro, awnlet ≤2 mm), not two values. Split that part off: awn (PO:0025349) or mucro at the glume apex, length up to 2 mm, or hold it.
reason: The disjunction is in the second part, not in the glume's quality. The glume statement itself can be annotated with existing terms.

fix: Resolve 'each containing' to the subject of the clause ('Locules'). Seed, amount 1, container locule (PO:0025263).
reason: The container is named in the same sentence. The annotator did not follow 'each' back to it.

fix: The quality must be extrorse (FLOPO:0991165, which allows anther PO:0009066), not 'present'.
reason: The text says the anther locules are extrorse. 'present' does not match.

fix: '2-6 mm thick' is a measurement of the attribute thickness (or diameter for an axis), not the value 'thick'. Add a grounding rule: number + unit + 'thick' → thickness.
reason: The quality was transcribed as a value word when the text gives a measured dimension.

target: biserrate / doubly serrate (margin teeth themselves serrate)
fix: Add a FLOPO value under serrated (PATO:0001206). 'serrate and/or biserrate' is then a pattern 07 union of serrated and biserrate on the leaf margin. 'acutely' and the gland-tipped teeth are separate.
reason: The structure is a plain union. PATO and FLOPO have no doubly serrate value.

fix: Accept '±' (as 'c.' already is) between 'to' and the number. Inclusive upper bounds of length 16 cm and width 8 cm on the leaf, marked approximate (pattern 01).
reason: Pattern 02 lists 'to c. 2 m'. The '±' form of the same cue is missing.

target: numerous / many (a count without a number)
fix: 'many flowered': the suffix 'flowered' is already in flora_counted_parts.tsv (→ flower). Count value 'numerous' (synonym many) as in P01681, with the scape/inflorescence as container. '>100-flowered' could be a lower bound with 'sometimes'.
reason: Same missing qualitative count value as the other 'numerous' items.

fix: Add grounding rows: 'lavender' → light purple (PATO:0001260); 'light blue-violet' → light violet (PATO:0001704), marked approximate. Then it is a union of three colours with white (PATO:0000323).
reason: The union pattern exists. Two colour words lack a rule to existing PATO colours.

fix: Add the unit 'dm' (decimetre) to the unit table. Whole plant height: usual range 3–6 dm, extremes 2 and 7.
reason: This is a plain range with extremes. The unit 'dm' is apparently not recognised.

fix: 'entire or sometimes obscurely scalloped': entire, or scalloped (PATO:0001889) with frequency 'sometimes'. Add 'obscurely' as a degree cue (approximately/weakly), as for '±'.
reason: Both values exist. Only the 'obscurely' modifier blocks it.

target: twining (climbing by the stem winding spirally round a support)
fix: Add a FLOPO value 'twining' as a child of climbing (FLOPO:0991108) for stems and whole plants. Give the FLOPO twining phenotype class the EQ stem + twining.
reason: This is a key habit character in Convolvulaceae and Fabaceae. 'climbing' exists, but the twining kind has no class with an EQ signature.

target: gland-tipped (ending in a gland at the apex)
fix: Add a FLOPO value under glandular (PATO:0002117). The stage 'in fruit' is kind A (already done) and 'becoming' is the existing transition.
reason: The stage and transition parts are covered. Only the value is missing.

fix: Bearer: the hairs (trichome), part of the costule, midvein and veinlets (pattern 12 container), quality length ca. 0.5 mm (approximate). Not vein + 'hairs'.
reason: The measurement is the length of the hairs, not a quality of the vein.

fix: Slots: counted part (here rows of sori, a collection as in 'jugate'), amount with bounds, container (pinna), and a position part (the side of the leaf midvein PO:0020139, as a BSPO lateral region) with 'per side' kept. OWL: has part some (sorus and part of some (lateral region and part of some pinna)) with an amount data range. RDF keeps 'per side' and the cue.
reason: The docs list counts at a position as still open.

fix: Add the row 'serrate → tooth' to config/flora_counted_parts.tsv, so '2-6-serrate' is a tooth count of 2–6 on the margin. The '(upper)'/'(lower)' leaves stay open (kind D members of a series).
reason: This is a count inside a word whose suffix is not in the table.

fix: As P01703: secondary veins (leaf lamina vein PO:0020138), amount 10–13, container leaf lamina, position = each side of the leaf midvein (PO:0020139), 'per side' in RDF.
reason: Same open construction as P01703.

target: long-acuminate → rule to acuminate PATO:0002228 (no new class)
fix: Add a rule mapping 'long-acuminate' to acuminate, marked as a longer form in RDF. 'acuminate to long-acuminate' then becomes acuminate, with no continuum needed.
reason: One value of the continuum has no grounding. A rule is enough.

target: leaf lamina base, not leaf blade
fix: 'rounded to acutish at the base': bearer = base of the leaf blade (slot 1 region), continuum from rounded to acute, with 'acutish' as approximate (pattern 01).
reason: The quality describes the blade base, not the whole blade.

target: exostome and endostome (outer and inner rings of the moss peristome; endostome basal membrane)
fix: Add the anatomy classes (FLOPO under peristome PO:0030042) or ask PO. Then pattern 10: basal membrane decreased length towards exostome, ratio 0.5.
reason: The relation fits pattern 10, but neither part grounds.

fix: Whole plant height: usual range 3–6 m, extremes 2 and 10. Check that the en-dash form '(2–)3–6(–10)' and the trailing 'm. tall' are parsed and not taken as alternatives.
reason: This is a plain range with extremes, wrongly flagged as alternatives.

fix: Flower, amount = 'numerous' (as P01681), with the inflorescence as container.
reason: Same missing qualitative count value.

target: numerous / many (a count without a number)
fix: Pairs of leaflets (as for 'jugate', collection of 2), amount = 'numerous' (synonym many), container the pinna/leaf.
reason: The structure is the jugate count. Only a non-numeric count value is missing.

fix: A colour range must not go to the measurement parser. Continuum from light green (PATO:0001250) to red brown (PATO:0001287, synonym reddish brown) on the stem.
reason: Both colours ground in PATO. 'measurement_missing_unit' is a misrouting caused by 'to'.

fix: As P01705: lateral (secondary) veins, amount 2–4, container leaf lamina, position = each side of the midrib, 'per side' in RDF.
reason: Same open construction as P01703 and P01705.

fix: Read fraction words ('one eighth', 'one tenth' → 0.125, 0.1): costa (PO:0030072) has decreased width towards the leaf (phyllid), ratio 0.1–0.125. Keep 'lower part' as a region of the target in RDF. The '30 µ wide' is a separate measurement.
reason: This is a ratio to another part. Pattern 10 does not yet read fraction words.

fix: Add a rule: 'rooting at X' → adventitious (shoot-borne) root present, at the region X of the stem (here the stem base). This is the 'presence of a part at a place' form the doc gives for processes.
reason: This is not an event but the presence of roots at a place, which the doc already describes. A wording rule is missing.

fix: Slots: bearer (hypanthium PO:0009065), relational quality increased elevation relative to (PATO:0002515) towards the ovary apex, plus a magnitude with unit (0.3 mm, approximate). OWL: has characteristic some ('increased elevation relative to' and towards some ovary). Number and unit in RDF.
reason: Pattern 09 says 'comparisons with a measurement are not read'. This construction (prolonged N mm above X) is common in Myrtaceae.

fix: Spikelet (PO:0009051), amount = 'numerous', container the capitate inflorescence.
reason: Same missing qualitative count value.

fix: 'rarely' is a frequency qualifier, not negation. Adaxial surface (slot 1, substituted epidermis) is glabrous with frequency 'rarely', as the alternative to the 'pilose or villous' statement.
reason: The annotator read 'rarely' as a negation cue. The surface slot and the frequency qualifier both exist.

fix: 'even 5 m high' is a maximum extreme beside the usual 1–3 m. Add 'even' as a cue for an extreme, and keep 'according to Watson' as source attribution in RDF.
reason: This is a reported rare extreme of the same height, not a new bound.
